babaylan/set-1/unseen-passage-argao-rive.name: Unseen Passage, Argao River
babaylan/set-1/unseen-passage-argao-rive.skill:
Auto-switch — before you draw, if your opponent has more cards in hand than you, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Andukha: released while your Heart holds 6 or more cards.
1/Turn: Codex skill — When this Codex becomes active, Kalas any number of cards. Draw 1 card for every 5 cards vented this way.
babaylan/set-1/unseen-passage-argao-rive.gameplay: Funds and strengthens one carousel call each turn.
babaylan/set-1/unseen-passage-argao-rive.balance: Once per turn and battle phase only.

babaylan/set-1/fields-under-watch-tabaya.name: Fields Under Watch, Tabayag
babaylan/set-1/fields-under-watch-tabaya.skill:
Auto-switch — at the start of your Main Phase, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Andukha: released while your Heart holds 6 or more cards.
1/Turn: Codex skill — At the start of your Main Phase, Sanib the top card of your deck. If it was a Unit, create a Kaluluwa token in your Heart.
babaylan/set-1/fields-under-watch-tabaya.gameplay: Helps slower hands reach Andukha 6 but turns off once the state is established.
babaylan/set-1/fields-under-watch-tabaya.balance: Stops at six and carries deck pressure.

babaylan/set-1/living-sanctuary-dingayop.name: Living Sanctuary, Dingayop Spring
babaylan/set-1/living-sanctuary-dingayop.skill:
Auto-switch — when your Persona is under attack, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Andukha: released while your Heart holds 6 or more cards.
1/Turn: Codex skill — When you check a Barrier and it is not a Force, create 2 Kaluluwa tokens in your Heart, then discard 1 card.
babaylan/set-1/living-sanctuary-dingayop.gameplay: Replaces some Heart count lost to calling and feeds token payoffs.
babaylan/set-1/living-sanctuary-dingayop.pattern: Luquier field building with soul replacement

babaylan/set-1/hidden-court-dingayop-cav.name: Hidden Court, Dingayop Cavern
babaylan/set-1/hidden-court-dingayop-cav.skill:
Auto-switch — before you draw, if your opponent has more Units than you, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Andukha: released while your Heart holds 6 or more cards.
Codex skill — While this is active, whenever you Sanib a Unit from your field or your deck during your Main Phase, create a Kaluluwa token in your Heart as well.
babaylan/set-1/hidden-court-dingayop-cav.gameplay: Uses Heart defensively and makes token-heavy lists harder to break.
babaylan/set-1/hidden-court-dingayop-cav.balance: Only +5000 and once per turn; consumes two Heart.

babaylan/set-1/champion-s-trial-danao-hi.name: Champion's Trial, Danao Highlands
babaylan/set-1/champion-s-trial-danao-hi.skill:
Auto-switch — when your Persona attacks, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Andukha: released while your Heart holds 6 or more cards.
Codex skill — When your Persona attacks, it gets Power +1000 for each Kaluluwa token in your Heart. At the end of your turn, Kalas 3.
babaylan/set-1/champion-s-trial-danao-hi.gameplay: Makes a Divine Heart call hit hard and optionally stores it again.
babaylan/set-1/champion-s-trial-danao-hi.pattern: Pale Moon called-unit scaling and return
babaylan/set-1/champion-s-trial-danao-hi.balance: One Unit per turn; returning it costs board presence.

babaylan/set-1/turning-pursuit-bantayan-.name: Turning Pursuit, Bantayan Waters
babaylan/set-1/turning-pursuit-bantayan-.skill:
Auto-switch — when your Barrier breaks during your opponent's turn, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Andukha: released while your Heart holds 6 or more cards.
Codex skill — 1/Turn: The next time your Persona is attacked, it gets Power +1000 for each Kaluluwa token in your Heart until end of battle.
babaylan/set-1/turning-pursuit-bantayan-.gameplay: Clears an exhausted attacker into Heart and improves the next carousel hand.
babaylan/set-1/turning-pursuit-bantayan-.balance: Card-neutral and removes the attacker from the field.

babaylan/set-1/faithless-prison-tanon-st.name: Faithless Prison, Tañon Strait
babaylan/set-1/faithless-prison-tanon-st.skill:
Auto-switch — before you draw, if you have 2 or fewer Barriers, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Andukha: released while your Heart holds 6 or more cards.
1/Turn: Codex skill — When this Codex becomes active, Kalas 2. Choose one of the cards vented this way and special call it to an open Ally Zone; exile the other.
babaylan/set-1/faithless-prison-tanon-st.gameplay: Turns exhaustion into better attacks against that unit and feeds Doro.
babaylan/set-1/faithless-prison-tanon-st.partners: Thunder Beneath the Waves, Doro, Maguayan
babaylan/set-1/faithless-prison-tanon-st.pattern: Dark Irregulars board control with threshold bonus
babaylan/set-1/faithless-prison-tanon-st.balance: No removal and one target per turn.

babaylan/set-1/great-calling-moonwake-sh.name: Great Calling, Moonwake Shore
babaylan/set-1/great-calling-moonwake-sh.skill:
Auto-switch — before you draw, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Andukha: released while your Heart holds 6 or more cards.
Codex skill — Instead of drawing, create 2 Kaluluwa tokens in your Heart. If Andukha is released, draw 1 card.
babaylan/set-1/great-calling-moonwake-sh.gameplay: Large Kalas costs rebuild a small part of the field and reward committing to a payoff turn.
babaylan/set-1/great-calling-moonwake-sh.balance: Level 1 only; it attacks immediately only after Kalas 6.
